paraphrase: The Śaiva (Yauga) ascetics' god Śaṅkara has eighteen avatāras whom they worship at every step as tīrtheśas - from Nakulīśa, Kauśika, Gārgya, Maitrya and Kauruṣa to Rāśīkara (seventeenth) and Vidyāguru; Akṣapāda is their guru; bharaṭas of any varṇa who have devotion to Śiva take the vow and serve as priests in all their tīrthas.
notes: Opponent's / outsider's report: Rājaśekhara Sūri, Jain doxographer. checked against the local e-text in sources_raw (appendix to Dalal 1920).
